$description: The section list the colour documentation shares across its two surfaces. Recorded from the LIVE Figma frame; gated against the website by scripts/check-color-docs.mjs.
$why: Both surfaces are already pinned to one source for VALUES — Figma by variable binding, the website by generated data. Structure is the one thing neither pins, and structure is what makes two documents read as one. Section 12 of the Figma page and section 12 of the web page must be about the same thing.
$refresh: CI cannot reach Figma, so this file is refreshed by a human with library access: read the frame's top-level child names and re-record `sections` below in order. Do that in the same commit as any Figma restructure — the gate will otherwise fail on the website side, which is the wrong place to look.
